FLA.head: Florida has nearly everything going for them
FLA.body: Florida has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Vancouver’s only real way in is keeping dangerous shots away, and they would need a near-perfect night.

VAN.head: A steep climb for Vancouver
VAN.body: Florida has controlled the play far better over recent games and has home ice. Vancouver could still pull it off if they keep dangerous shots away, but they might need a miracle.
